exclusions.source_text: ECOG performance status = 0, 1 (Karnofsky ≥60%, see Appendix A)
Participants currently receiving systemic therapy for any malignancy or having received systemic therapy for a malignancy in the preceding 3 years.
History of angina pectoris, symptomatic pericarditis, coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) or myocardial infarction within 6 months prior to study entry.
known cardiomyopathy (LVEF \< 50%; new LVEF assessment is not specifically required for this trial)
Pregnant or breast-feeding women are excluded from this study because the safety of study medications is not established.
HIV-infected patients on effective anti-retroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months prior to enrollment are eligible for this trial.
